attempts.result: All 20 normal/marker pairs completed and matched the existing models. Diagnostic marker widths and stricter neighboring profiles were added during review before the first bounded rerun; all 20 pairs passed. Four ornament records, their 212 repeated marks, clipping and full paint-kind order were then added before this final bounded rerun.

The two QPainter drawImage entry points had zero observed calls for an original two-glyph control; existing pixmap observations were unchanged. This repeats, rather than expands, the previous observer limitation. Both sessions retain source integrity and confirmed cleanup.

An older HN-B control was initially read with a C8 page-count offset and was refused before any viewer launched. A new original C8 two-glyph control replaced that manifest; the failed attempt remains external.

limits: Expected transforms and roles follow published original controls; original MIT Rust was consulted. This is not an independently rediscovered geometry rule.
Marker role identity uses only original generated glyphs, CID mappings, outlines, advance metrics and PDF widths. Ordinary/vendor font outlines are not inspected.
Normal PDF marker roles are not checked; font substitution and one ActualText visual alias remain explicit.

Ornament repetition, matrices, clips, gray and kind order are checked; the default arrow alias is not the vendor ornament outline. No original-font, raster, whole-page composition or cold-session consistency pass is inferred.
